headline: MB Becomes the First Bank in Vietnam to Exceed 100,000 Billion Dong in Charter Capital
summary: Military Commercial Joint Stock Bank has completed a capital increase to 100,687.5 billion dong, becoming the first Vietnamese bank above 100,000 billion dong. The bank says the move creates room to expand and invest in technology.
why: Charter capital is a bank's registered equity base, which determines lending capacity and regulatory headroom. Capital increases often support balance sheet growth and investment plans.
